changeSet.author: dojo
changeSet.sql: UPDATE roux_theme t SET app_name = a.app_name, palette = a.palette, brand_color = a.brand_color, shape = a.shape, heading_font = a.heading_font, body_font = a.body_font, version = a.version + 1, created_date = a.created_date, modified_date = a.modified_date, created_by = a.created_by, modified_by = a.modified_by FROM app_theme a WHERE a.id = t.id
